principle: Imagery earns its place by scale and quality; a small image in a box competes with the text instead of supporting it.
detect: A hero image sitting in a rounded, bordered, shadowed card beside the copy; decorative blobs; emoji used as artwork.
fix: Give one image or art element real weight, full-bleed or near it, and set text on it behind a contrast overlay of at least 4.5:1.
